items.summary: GPU random number generator not enabled on HIP: include/visionaray/random_generator.h guards the thrust include and rand_engine device path under #if defined(__CUDACC__) only, so device RNG is unavailable under __HIPCC__. Small fix (extend both guards to accept __HIPCC__/__HIP_DEVICE_COMPILE__); needs GPU revalidation of any sampler path using it.

hipCreateTextureObject with filterMode=Linear + readMode=ElementType over float faults on gfx90a/CDNA2 at sample time (tex3D). CUDA hardware supports HW linear-float filtering; CDNA2 does not. Surfaces and nearest-filtered volumes render fine on gfx90a; only linear-filtered float textures (e.g. structuredRegular volume default filter=linear) fault. Fix in base visionaray: software-emulate linear filtering for float readMode=ElementType on devices lacking HW support (or document the limitation). Surfaced validating anari-visionaray structuredRegular volumes on MI250X.

visionaray hip::device_vector host-side container interface (reserve/push_back/emplace_back/clear, std::vector<T,A> ctor+conversion, capacity_) was added to the fork (moat-port 421da19b) to mirror cuda::device_vector, required by anari-visionaray's GPU BVH-builder path. visionaray gfx90a already landed upstream (1b0b5813) WITHOUT this, so it needs its own upstream follow-up PR to szellmann/visionaray. Until then, consumers (anari-visionaray reviewer/validator + any other host) must build against AMD-Ecosystem/visionaray @ moat-port, not upstream. advance-head flipped visionaray's non-gfx90a platforms to revalidate.
